test_title: PYST 3: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

J _ JJ _ _ JM _ _ MJ
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: J _ JJ _ _ JM _ _ MJ

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) JJMMJ → J __J__ J / J __J__ __M__ / J M __M__ / __J__ MJ

Option 2) MMJJJ
